overview: White plays 3.f3 against the Grünfeld set-up, then after 3...d5 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5.e4 Nb6 builds a large pawn centre of d4, e4 and f3. Black attacks it with ...Bg7, ...O-O and ...c5 or ...e5 breaks. Play is a classic hypermodern battle between centre and pieces.

white_ideas.idea: Hold the big centre with Nc3, Be3 and Qd2
Castle queenside for a possible kingside pawn storm

typical_structures.structure: White d4/e4/f3 pawn trio against Black piece pressure

character.notes: Black counterattacks a large centre; tension but not forced.

structure.notes: White centre against hypermodern pieces; tension in the centre.

approach.notes: The Neo-Grünfeld Goglidze is a rare anti-Grünfeld.

level.notes: Both centre handling and some theory.

character.reason: Centre vs pieces, chances for both.

structure.reason: Centre contested rather than locked or open.

plans.reason: White big centre, Black hypermodern counterplay.
